heroSubheading: Where Waihi buys STIHL equipment, parts, and service
aboutHtml:
We're Greg and Siobhan McLarnon, running STIHL SHOP Waihi for locals who need reliable outdoor power equipment. We stock a full range of STIHL gear, from chainsaws to trimmers and everything in between.

Our workshop services and repairs STIHL equipment, and we stock parts to keep you running. We give honest advice about what will work for your job, whether you're clearing land, cutting firewood, or maintaining your property.

Come in and talk to us on weekdays or Saturday morning. We'll help you get the right equipment and keep it in good order.
